name: assign a variable, propagate forced consequences, backtrack on conflict
mechanism: choose an unassigned variable and a value, repeatedly assign every literal forced by a clause with one unassigned literal, and on an empty clause undo to the last choice and try the other value

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Davis–Putnam–Logemann–Loveland algorithm (DPLL)' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: an algorithm for deciding the satisfiability of propositional logic formula in conjunctive normal form, i.e. for solving the CNF-SAT problem
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Chaff algorithm': an algorithm for solving instances of the Boolean satisfiability problem
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Davis–Putnam algorithm': check the validity of a first-order logic formula

requires: a variable-choice rule (policy; the whole practical difference)
fails_when: exponential without learning; clause learning and watched literals are the engineering (Chaff)
